version: RT-V2-01 spec (final-audit 2026-11-04), derived from mNLNb-Z4T0M native-frame measurements
implementation_limit: Compressed output reveals geometry and frame timing only; source software, fonts, layer stack, easing curves and asset origin are UNAVAILABLE. Frame numbers at 30000/1001 fps, +-1 frame.

test_scene.board_colour: #3b4f3a (uniform, you must use exactly this flat colour for the board area)

modules.label: MEASURED (4 events: S062 f5864-5870, S069 f6567-6572, S094 f9771-9776, S122 f14310-14317)
modules.observation: A rectangular picture panel on the board collapses vertically into a thin horizontal band, its content is replaced while it is a band, then it re-expands vertically to exactly its previous size. Width does not change.

spec.overshoot: NONE: the panel never exceeds its settled size on re-expansion
spec.content_swap: new picture content visible from the first band frame or the first expansion frame

modules.observation: Continuous push-in/reframe of an illustrated scene: every consecutive frame changes, speed rises then falls, then the image is at rest (no held/stepped frames during the move).

spec.speed_profile: ease-in-out; peak speed in the middle third of the move
